lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrZn₃ crystallizes in the trigonal space group P3m1 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing four atoms—one Sr and three Zn—distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Sr centers coordinated by nine Zn neighbors, while Zn environments involve either five or six neighbors (five Zn, one Sr). The periodic neighbor graph is fully three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between 5- and 6-vertex Zn coordination polyhedra, as well as corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 6-vertex Zn polyhedra.
